Hi Samantha — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Procurement path: you mentioned Acme prefers PO for purchases over $50k and corporate card for smaller purchases. Can you confirm threshold and whether a standalone PO is expected or if Procurement requires DocuSign/contract first?

2) Marketplace: you said there may be interest in AWS Marketplace, but finance needs vendor listing. Is marketplace ingestion a requirement for procurement/approval?

3) Budget & signatory owners: please confirm the economic buyer and the person who signs (VP Finance vs Legal). If you can share names/emails, we’ll route the commercial package directly.

4) Next steps from Redwood: Vivek and Rishi will prepare a commercial summary, sample PO language, and our SOC2 summary. I’ve attached the commercial sheet and SOC2 summary for review.

Attachments: Redwood-Commercial-Sheet.pdf, Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf

If you can reply with answers to 1–3 and preferred timing for a quick call with your procurement lead, I’ll coordinate. Thanks!

— Marissa

marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>

Subject: Re: Procurement & approvals for Redwood trial / Acme Corp

Hi Marissa,

Great to chat — thanks for the clear recap. Answers below: 

1) PO vs Card: Confirmed — standard policy is PO for anything >$50,000/yr. One-off trial or POC costs under $5k–10k we can put on a corporate card. Anything between $10k–50k is evaluated case-by-case but typically goes to a central purchasing request.

2) Marketplace: AWS Marketplace is not a blocker but Procurement likes vendors to be listed so they can do SSO/chargeback. That will speed long-term renewals, but we can start with a direct purchase if we have acceptable contract terms.

3) Budget & signatory:
   - Economic buyer / budget owner: Tom Alvarez (VP Finance) — tom.alvarez@acmecorp.com
   - Procurement lead / finance sponsor: me (Samantha Lee) — samantha.lee@acmecorp.com
   - Legal / signatory: final signatory is Tom (VP Finance) for deals under $250k; larger deals go to General Counsel.

I’m attaching our PO template to speed things up. Let me know if you want me to intro Tom on the next thread. We can target a technical + procurement sync next Thursday.

Attachment: ACME_PO_Template.docx

Thanks,
Samantha
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp
